css: .container.is-wide { max-width: 1440px; } .gallery-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr 1fr 1.4fr; grid-column-gap: 16px; height: 420px; } .gallery-cell { border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; } .gallery-cell.is-offset { margin-top: 64px; } @media screen and (max-width: 991px) { .gallery-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; height: auto; grid-row-gap: 16px; } .gallery-cell { height: 320px; } .gallery-cell.is-offset { margin-top: 0; } } @media screen and (max-width: 479px) { .gallery-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
